subject: Hosted API annual usage agreement — tier options and MAP
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API annual usage agreement — tier options and MAP

Hi Emma,

Great speaking yesterday — follow-up with the annual usage options we discussed for ClearBridge. To make the evaluation and procurement path as straightforward as possible, we put together three recommended tiers for hosted API usage and the baseline commercial terms. Attached: pricing_matrix.xlsx (per-token examples + overage rules) and a draft SOW (ClearBridge_SOW_v1.pdf).

High-level tiers (annual commitment, hosted API):
- Starter: 3M tokens / year (avg ~250k/month). List price $0.00095/token; volume discount schedule begins at 10M+ tokens. Ideal for early feature testing and light production. Includes 2 seats for Console and 30k tokens onboarding credit.
- Growth: 60M tokens / year (avg ~5M/month). List price $0.00070/token; recommended package with model selection help and monthly usage review. Includes standard SLA (99.9%), 100k onboarding credits, and access to Redwood Optimize recommendations.
- Enterprise: 600M tokens / year (avg ~50M/month). List price $0.00045/token; includes higher priority routing, dedicated capacity options, quarterly QBRs, and extended security bundle (KMS integration). Concierge onboarding, 250k onboarding credits.

Key commercial notes:
- Overage: billed at list price with monthly reconciliation; we can layer a blended overage protection at contract signing for Growth+ tiers.
- Carryover: up to 25% of unused monthly tokens can be carried forward (annual cap applies).
- Billing: monthly invoices, Net-30. Annual prepay available for additional discount.
- SLA: baseline 99.9% uptime for Growth and above; Enterprise can include custom SLAs in SOW.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II report available; we can provide scoped evidence for procurement.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan / MAP):
1) You select target tier and confirm any region/SLA constraints (this week).
2) Redwood sends final SOW + commercial redlines for legal review (Monica/Vivek) — target by 11/09.
3) Procurement review + DocuSign sign-off (ClearBridge) — target by 11/20.
4) Onboarding kick (technical onboarding + integration tasks) — target by 11/30.

If helpful I can sketch a sample 6-month ramp (tokens and expected latency/cost buckets) tailored to the features you mentioned. For negotiation flexibility: Growth tier is our most popular path — we can do an introductory commercial concession if you commit to the annual plan and prepay.

Thanks — would you like us to mark this as a draft to share with procurement, or should I send a cleaner SOW for legal?

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pricing_matrix.xlsx (pricing + examples), ClearBridge_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW)

From: Emma Chen <emma@clearbridge.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API annual usage agreement — tier options and MAP

Monica — thanks for the summary and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from procurement and product: 

1) Ramp/carryover: clear if carryover is allowed up to 25%, but can you confirm how that interacts with monthly overage billing? Example: if we commit to Growth (60M/yr) and have a Q1 underutilization, do we get credit against Q2 usage or does it only apply within the annual accounting window?
2) Minimum commitment: is Starter allowed to convert to Growth mid-year? Any mid-term repricing?
3) Discounts: ClearBridge is evaluating Growth as the likely target but procurement is asking if Redwood can provide a 12% list-level discount on the Growth list price in exchange for annual prepay and a 6-month pilot commitment.
4) Security: SOC2 attestation is required — can you share the latest report and the data-residency regions for hosted infra? We need to confirm data residency for some regulated datasets.
5) Billing: would prefer quarterly billing for forecasting — is that an option or is monthly required?

Procurement copied here (procurement@clearbridge.ai) — I’m the product lead and will coordinate with legal. Once we have those details we’ll route the draft SOW to legal.

Thanks,
Emma Chen
Director of Product, ClearBridge AI
emma@clearbridge.ai

On Wed, Nov 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API annual usage agreement — tier options and MAP

Emma — thanks for the good questions. Answers inline below + a revised commercial suggestion that should address procurement’s asks.

1) Ramp / carryover: carryover credits roll forward month-to-month up to the 25% annual cap and are reconciled on the monthly invoice. Practically: if Q1 is underspent we apply credit against the next invoice(s) until exhausted. The annual accounting window is used only for any unused tokens beyond the carryover cap.

2) Mid-term changes: you can upgrade tiers mid-year without penalty; downgrades only at renewal (we do allow negotiated exceptions in special cases). Upgrades will be priced at the then-current list rate less agreed discounts.

3) Discounts / pilot ask: we can do the following concession structure for Growth if you commit to the annual plan and prepay:
   - Standard concession: 10% off the Growth list price on the annual committed volume (requires annual prepay).
   - If ClearBridge is willing to commit to a 6-month performance pilot clause (metrics-based: latency <200ms p50, token quality score threshold), we can extend to 12% off on the committed volume. Pilot would be rolled into the MAP and not counted as separate billing if successful.

4) Security / SOC2: we’ll share the most recent SOC 2 Type II attestation and a scoped evidence packet (logs, data handling notes). Hosted infra regions: us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 secondary; we can lock data residency in us-west-2 in the SOW for regulated workloads.

5) Billing cadence: monthly billing is default. Quarterly billing is possible for Growth+ if you sign a quarterly invoicing addendum (will require PO + payment terms adjusted; we can include that in the SOW).

Additional commercial sweetener for Enterprise: 15% off list price with annual prepay + a 3-month onboarding credit and concierge integration sessions (up to 20 engineering hours) — available if you plan to centralize inference for multiple product lines.

Proposed updated MAP milestones: 
- 11/09: Redwood provides updated SOW that includes data residency lock and quarterly billing addendum (if you prefer) + SOC2 attestation.
- 11/12: ClearBridge internal approval and procurement confirmation of pilot metrics.
- 11/20: Final signatures and invoicing.

I’m attaching a short sample MAP and the redlined pricing matrix (see pricing_matrix.xlsx). If you’d like, I can also sketch the 6-month ramp down to token buckets and expected cost over time so procurement can see monthly spend variance.

Let me know if the 12% tier under pilot conditions works and I’ll escalate the concession to my manager for sign-off.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pricing_matrix.xlsx (updated)

Emma / team — quick note from Redwood leadership: we’re prepared to approve the 12% Growth concession tied to the 6-month pilot metrics Monica outlined, and we’ll add a $5k evaluation credit to support the pilot instrumentation and early integration work. Action items for procurement/legal:

1) Monica — please send the updated SOW with the pilot clause, data residency lock to us-west-2, quarterly billing addendum (if ClearBridge confirms), and the SOC2 attestation link.
2) Emma / procurement — once you confirm the pilot metrics in writing we will lock the concession and generate RBW-DEAL-7892 commercial terms for signature.

We appreciate ClearBridge moving quickly on this — the pilot + annual Growth path looks like a great fit. Monica will run the MAP and I’ll be available for any final commercial approvals.
